map.按模拟天气与植物需水量，生成分区浇灌排程（雨天跳过、高温加浇）: Generate a zoned irrigation schedule from simulated or manually entered weather and plant water demand; rainy days are skipped and hot weather raises demand
map.浇灌排程 = 需水量/流量: Irrigation schedule = water demand / flow rate
map.浇灌区域（名称 + 植物类型 + 面积㎡）: Irrigation zones (name + plant type + area in ㎡)
map.物业绿化组按季节与植被类型制定每周浇灌计划，避开雨天: The property greening team sets weekly watering plans by season and vegetation type, avoiding rainy days
map.干旱期提高草坪浇灌频次，雨季自动降低: Increase lawn watering frequency during droughts and reduce it automatically in the rainy season
map.新栽苗木前 30 天加密浇灌，之后回落到常规频次: Intensify watering for the first 30 days after planting, then fall back to the normal frequency
map.草坪需水 8 L/㎡·次、每周 2 次、面积 1200 ㎡ → 单次用水 960: Lawn demand 8 L/㎡·session, twice weekly, area 1200 ㎡ → 9600 L per session and 19200 L per week. When the chance of rain that day exceeds 60%, skip and defer, preventing root rot and waste.
map.乔木 15 L/株·次（每周 1 次）、灌木 6 L/株·次（每周 2 次），共: Trees 15 L/plant·session (once a week), shrubs 6 L/plant·session (twice a week), 80 trees + 200 shrubs → 1200 + 2400 = 3600 L per week; scheduling lawns separately avoids overpressuring the pipe network.
map.怎么判断某天要不要浇？: How do you decide whether to water on a given day?
map.看当日降雨概率与土壤墒情：概率高或刚下过雨则跳过；连续晴热且墒情低才按计划浇，避: Look at the rain probability and soil moisture: skip if rain is likely or it just rained; only water on schedule after sustained hot dry weather with low moisture, avoiding waterlogging and waste.
map.不同植被能共用一张排程吗？: Can different vegetation share one schedule?
map.不能，草坪、乔木、灌木的需水量与频次差异很大，应分类型排程并分别计算工作量。: No. Lawns, trees and shrubs differ greatly in water demand and frequency, so schedule by type and compute workload separately.
map.按模拟天气（晴/阴/雨）与各区域植物需水量，自动生成多日浇灌排程，雨天跳过、高温: Automatically generates a multi-day irrigation schedule from simulated weather (sunny/cloudy/rainy) and per-zone plant water demand, skipping rainy days and adding extra watering in hot weather.
map.绿化浇灌排程生成器 - 按天气模拟生成浇灌排程，免费在线物业管理工具。。商业办公: Greening Irrigation Schedule Generator - generate an irrigation schedule from weather simulation. Free online property management tool. Business and office tool to improve work efficiency, data processed locally to protect privacy.
map.浇灌排程模拟（无流量输入，按需水基准×温度系数）：单次水量 = 区域面积 × 植: Irrigation schedule simulation (no flow input; demand baseline × temperature factor): water per session = zone area × plant baseline demand × temperature factor (L) - lawn 8, shrubs 6, flowers 10, trees 20, succulents 2 (L/m²·session); irrigation interval = max(1, round(7 ÷ desired times per week)), and a day is only irrigated when simulated rainfall <=0.15; the temperature factor is 1.2 when the period mean is >30°C, 1.1 when >25°C, otherwise 1; zone total water = water per session × actual irrigation days, total = Σ zones (L). Weather is generated pseudo-randomly day by day from a random seed (rain probability parameter).
map.按随机模拟或手动输入的逐日天气与各区域植物需水量，生成多日浇灌排程；天气不是实时: Generate a multi-day schedule from randomly simulated or manually entered daily weather and per-zone plant water demand; weather is not a live forecast, and rain days are skipped without shifting.
map.手动天气（每行：第N天,天气,温度℃,雨量mm；须覆盖 1–所选天数）: Manual weather (one line: day N, weather, temperature°C, rainfall mm; must cover days 1 to the selected count)
map.示例中第 2 天雨量 0.6mm 视为有效降水；天气文字可填 晴/阴/小雨/大雨: In the example, 0.6 mm rain on day 2 counts as effective rain; weather text can be sunny/cloudy/light rain/heavy rain and is display-only.
map.单次水量 = 区域面积 × 植物基准需水 × 温度系数（L）——草坪 8、灌木: Water per run = zone area × plant base demand × temperature factor (L) - lawn 8, shrub 6, flowers 10, trees 20, succulents 2 (L/m²·run); interval = max(1, round(7 ÷ desired runs per week)); a day is actually watered only when rainfall ≤0.15 mm and the zone is on its interval day. The temperature factor is 1.2 when the period mean is >30°C, 1.1 when >25°C, otherwise 1; zone total = water per run × actual watering days. Weather may be randomly simulated (seed + rain probability) or entered manually day by day; both are planning assumptions, not live forecasts.
map.按区列出实际浇灌与跳过原因: Actual watering days and skip reasons per zone
map.天数与标题同步: Schedule days and title stay in sync
map.物业绿化组按季节与植被类型制定每周浇灌计划，用模拟天气做排程演练: The property landscaping team sets weekly watering plans by season and vegetation type, using simulated weather for scheduling drills
map.气象预报未覆盖或需要按既定天气条件复核排期时，手动逐日录入温度与雨量: When no forecast covers the period or fixed weather conditions must be applied, enter temperature and rainfall day by day
map.雨季检查各区域因降雨和间隔重叠被跳过的天数，避免漏浇或重复浇: In the rainy season, review days skipped because of rain and interval overlap to avoid missed or repeated watering
map.草坪需水 8 L/㎡·次、面积 1200 ㎡、期望每周 2 次 → 间隔 4 天: Lawn needs 8 L/m2 per run over 1200 m2, twice a week → a 4-day interval and 9600 L per run; with no effective rain in 14 days it waters on days 1, 5, 9 and 13, four times and 38400 L total.
map.灌木 6 L/㎡·次、面积 200 ㎡、间隔 4 天；若第 5 天雨量 0.6m: Shrubs need 6 L/m2 per run over 200 m2 on a 4-day interval; if day 5 has 0.6 mm rain (>0.15 mm), that day is skipped without shifting, the next run is still day 9, water per run is 1200 L and the total falls by 1200 L.
map.乔木 20 L/㎡·次、面积 300 ㎡、间隔 7 天 → 每周 6000 L；: Trees need 20 L/m2 per run over 300 m2 on a 7-day interval → 6000 L per week; the 1200 m2 lawn needs 19200 L per week; stagger the groups to avoid simultaneous pipe pressure.
map.只看所选天气条件下当日雨量：≤0.15mm 视为无有效降水，且该区域处于间隔日才: Use only the selected weather condition: rainfall ≤0.15 mm counts as no effective rain, and watering is scheduled only when the zone is on its interval day; above 0.15 mm that day is skipped. Simulated weather is not a forecast.
map.雨天跳过后会顺延吗？: Does a rain skip shift the schedule?
map.不会。雨天只跳过当天，下个间隔日再浇；因此连续降雨会减少总浇灌次数和总水量。: No. Rain skips only that day; watering resumes on the next interval day, so continuous rain reduces both the number of runs and total water.
map.不能。草坪、乔木、灌木的需水量与间隔差异很大，应按植物类型分区排程并分别核算水量: No. Lawns, trees and shrubs differ greatly in water demand and interval; schedule by plant type and calculate water separately.
